QuestInfo.name: Convincing Wu Gong 2
QuestInfo.0: Convincing #p2440000# to leave his comfortable home would take more time than Alpha and Beta had... so they decided to kidnap him. They turned to #b#p2440004##k in #m324000000# to help them find a recipe for a tranquilizer.
QuestInfo.1: #p2440004# asked for a supply of #b#t4009018##k and #b#t4009019##k to make the tranquilizer. Alpha and Beta made their way to #b#MDmirrorD_324_3_##k.
QuestInfo.2: With all the ingredients in-hand, they returned to #p2440004# for the tranquilizer.

0.0: Well if it isn't my two bare-cheeked new friends! What can I get you today? An herbal broth to polish your teeth and intestines? A frothing juice to enliven your bile production?
0.1: Monk tranquilizer? Aww, that's boring! Unless... I make one SO potent, it would put the entire town to sleep! This will be my greatest brew yet! Can you bring me some #b#t4009018##k and #b#t4009019##k items from #b#MDmirrorD_324_3_##k? Yes, yes, and a bag of peanut butter cups. They help me think.

yes.0: All right, all right, forget the peanut butter cups... if you dare. I just need #b10#k of each for this little concoction. I can't promise it will #blast very long#k, but you'll deal.

1.0: You got all the ingredients! Give me a sec while I brew up the sleep juice.
